scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm checking on the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what is the interest rate on the loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The interest rate on your loan is 6.125%.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for letting me know! What are the total costs associated with this loan? And is there any indication of high-cost or negative amortization on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The total costs associated with your loan are $8,421.40. Your loan does not have negative amortization, and it is not classified as a high-cost mortgage.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution, and what is my debt-to-income ratio?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has not been sold to another institution. Your debt-to-income ratio is 38%.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the information. I have all the details I need.

<Neutral> The agent was polite and provided the information I asked for, but I was hoping for a lower interest rate.
